_legend: Material-primary map format. Each stage's `cells` is a list of rows; a row is either a terrain-code string (compact) or a list of cells, where a cell is a terrain code or a {"t": material, "o": marker} object. A cell's terrain MATERIAL is the source of truth: its category decides walkability (barrier blocks), roof (interior is roofed), and appearance. Object markers (o): S run spawn (first segment only), X exit gate, c center, m mart, w wild, t route trainer, L leader, D gym door — they sit on walkable terrain. Terrain codes map to materials in ThemePalette.MATERIAL_CODE. Legacy `grid`/{g,m} cells are still read as a fallback. Stitched into one world at each stage's `world_pos`.
